title: The dyadic triangular Hilbert form
description: OpenAI's theorem (2026) that the dyadic triangular Hilbert form is bounded on L^3 x L^3 x L^3 uniformly in the scales and with no condition on the inputs: the absolute values of the local forms over admissible triples of dyadic intervals, summed over any finite set of scales, are at most 40 times the product of the L^3 norms. Step functions as matrices; the energy tr(P^(3/2)), its Hessian and its comparison under the matrix order; a dimension-free trace estimate for a triangle of matrices; energy increase under splitting into four children, and telescoping.

units.title: Dyadic triangles and the main estimate
A matrix energy and a trace inequality

prerequisites: linear algebra over R: symmetric matrices, the spectral theorem, positive semidefinite order, the trace; the inverse function theorem in finite dimensions
the Lebesgue integral, L^p spaces and Holder's inequality, as in Fremlin's Measure Theory (core course Measure and Integration)
